title: Half Marathon Races in the Philippines: 2026 Calendar
intro: Half marathon season in the Philippines runs hot from August through September, with 35 of the 50 races on this list falling in those two months alone before things taper off toward December. Cebu City and Pasay anchor much of the calendar, each hosting several separate events, while the rest of the field stretches from Clark and Pampanga down through Iloilo, Davao, Cagayan de Oro, and smaller regional stops like Guinobatan, Baao, and Dipolog City. Most races pair the 21.1km distance with 10km and 5km options, though a few, like Dagan Cebu, add a 16km or 12km tier. The choice comes down to timing your training around the August-September crunch versus the quieter, more spread-out October-to-December window.
